title: 900 written, labelled first requests to Home and a first intent classifier, kept in shadow
request: The owner: about 500 labelled requests are needed for an intent classifier and there are almost none; build them (plan P6, ~/.claude/plans/magical-waddling-honey.md).
spec: Code assigns each request's truth (kind of help, need, language, style); writers only write words; a plain reading checks them; an independent agent writes the sealed sets; the classifier is measured across writers and gated before any sealed read.

decisions.decision: A third writer (C), English only, of direct requests that name tables and columns
decisions.why: the first measurement missed plain requests ("predict which bookings get cancelled"); after the owner's "skip Persian" its early Persian batches were kept apart, unused

decisions.decision: The gate judges English requests only; Persian and mixed are reported
The classifier may answer alone only above confidence 0.86 and must be 95% right there and beat the rules by 10 points
decisions.why: the stricter of the two dev measurements; numbers set after dev and before any sealed read, as the file says
on Home's own requests the classifier ties the rules (0.72 against 0.70): a read now would spend the set on a likely fail

change: dclab_rnd.agent_eval.home.intent_requests and its data (intent_requests_v1, flagged, blind sample and key, manifest), intent_sealed_v1 and requests_sealed_v3 pinned, intent_gate_v1.json, the intent_model_v1 card and measurements (the fitted model is not committed), dclab_rnd.intent_classifier, prompts home_request_writer (b, c), the blind labelling guide, tests.

findings.defect: The classifier missed plain, direct requests from another writer
findings.scenario: Home's 108 requests read by the classifier trained on writers A and B.
findings.cause: The two writers favoured indirect, story-like requests.
findings.fix: Writer C wrote 300 direct requests; the classifier now holds 0.84 to 0.87 with one writer held out, and 0.72 on Home's own requests, still level with the rules.

findings.defect: The writing calls returned no thinking summary
findings.scenario: journey_writer calls with thinking asked: 1 of 95 with a summary.
findings.cause: Adaptive thinking at the default effort chooses not to think on short writing tasks.
findings.fix: The workspace now asks for effort xhigh (measured 3 of 3 with a summary); a test shows a returned summary is saved.

measurements.name: Intent classifier across writers (dev)
measurements.gate: intent_gate_v1, fixed before any sealed read
measurements.result: train A test B 0.78, train B test A 0.79, one writer held out 0.84-0.87; the rules 0.31-0.42 on the written sets; on Home's 108 requests 0.72 against the rules' 0.70; English 0.88, Persian 0.82, mixed 0.70

measurements.name: The written set's check
measurements.gate: the plain reading agrees with the assigned kind

outcome: 900 labelled requests and a shadow classifier; the sealed sets are pinned and unread; EUR 3.61 of a EUR 4 cap.
lessons: Written requests from two writers of one style teach a classifier that style: a third writer of another kind is what showed the gap.
A classifier that beats the rules on written sets can still only tie them on requests written elsewhere; real requests are the next data.
risks: Labels are written by design, kept apart and weighted lower than real labels; promotion needs the sealed set and real requests.
